steps.content: It's two hours before complete corrosion by the Ice Plague. You finally arrive at the place where the Dragon of Genesis' power is hidden.
Relentless blizzards cover the sky like flying white sand, ready to engulf the entire world.

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>In the core of the chill, amid the howling wind, an enormous figure crouches. A rumbling rises and falls slowly like low breaths.</color>

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>The figure in the gap of the storm is blurry and tremulous. At any second, it may be devoured, it may leave again and never come back.</color>

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>You know that's the long-missing Dragon of Genesis. The Chosen One has gathered all the legacies. According to the rules written by the Creator God, you're qualified to stand before it and decide the fate of this world.</color>
You hear the familiar voice in your heart again, but it also sounds like it comes from ahead. Taking two steps in the snowstorm, you find the girl you've met once before by the dragon's claws.
The troublemaker Sinner. The Game Master who created this game. She stares up blankly at the huge dragon, slowly raising a hand to stroke its massive but contorting body.

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: It's been a while... I forgot... what you looked like...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That's not the only thing you forgot, Etti.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The power you use for your creations is the extremely dangerous Mania power. Overusing it will only wear out your mind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your mind is already in peril, and the world you've created will soon be annihilated too. The people trapped here by you...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Are you fearing death?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Don't worry, when I finally break down, you'll all be automatically kicked out. You had a chance to experience such an amazing game, make sure you leave a good review and recommend it to all your friends.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Oops... You've distracted me. No one talks like that in the game.
Etti rises slowly, flying toward the top of the dragon's head. She turns to peer down at you. An invisible barrier expands and spreads to block out the storm, marking out a clear stage around you.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...No one has ever intruded into the very root of Aesthia. No one has ever... dared disturb the Dragon of Genesis' rest.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Who are you? Who dares challenge the truth of this world? Who gave you the courage?!
You feel a weight around your waist. A weapon has appeared aptly. Etti gazes down at you pompously. She looks slightly clumsy blocking the snow, but the anticipation in her eyes is barely concealed.
This is the end of the game. She is truly looking forward to the ending you're going to write.
You adopt a pose and slowly draw the sword on your waist, piercing the chilly air to point it at the dragon and the girl on top of it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm the Chosen One who holds the Fate Dice! My friends have cleared the way for me and lent me the courage to face you here!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You wrote the start of this world, and now I'm taking its ending!
She snorts loudly.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Hmph! Very well! Come on then! Let's see how you'll decide!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Will you pray to the Dragon of Genesis to end the Ice Plague and bring redemption? Or will you raise your blade, slice through the root, and let destruction descend?
Then, she spreads her arms as the dragon spreads its wings, facing you, the minuscule challenger.
The Dragon of Genesis' power fuses into her frail body, waking the dragon blood inside. The scattered ice and snow gather around her to forge a tough dragon armor.
As she transforms into the Dragon of Delusion and becomes enveloped by the ice armor, you see it clearly...
Etti can't help but beam with a brilliant smile.
